verified_sources.source_name: San Marco SpA Italy - Venetian Plasters & Decorative Systems Technical Manual
verified_sources.key_insights: Application methodologies for Stucco Veneziano, Marmorino Classico, Cadoro (Velvet effect), and Marcopolo Luxury. Stainless steel trowel burnishing, natural slaked lime (grassello di calce) formulations, and protective waxes.
Metallic velvet effects (Klondike, Sabulador, Polistof), quartz sands, acrylic resins, and humidity-resistant sealers for Gulf environments.

verified_sources.source_name: Kuwait Luxury Finishing & Majlis Craftsmanship Field Ledger
verified_sources.key_insights: Kuwait market pricing per square meter (materials + master artisan labor: 3.500 to 8.500 KWD/sqm). Popularity on reception walls, TV feature backdrops, dining rooms, and entrance foyers in Abdulla Al-Salem, Nuzha, Shamiya, and coastal chalets.
